stats.notes: There is no current Common Data Set: the newest one ESU posts on its Common Data Set page is 2018-19, so these are figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data, for the fall 2023 entering class. College Navigator's newer fall 2024 figures: 1,918 applicants, 98% admitted, 23% of admitted enrolled (no admit count is printed, so none is calculated). Counts are institution-wide first-time students; IPEDS gives no international split or GPA data. IPEDS reports no SAT percentiles or SAT submission rate for ESU. Undergraduate enrollment is 2,396 and the student-to-faculty ratio is 16:1 (College Navigator, fall 2024).
